Figure 15 and Figure 16 are comparably simple, when compared to the other 
activities; this intentional design decision aims to reduce extraneous load and 
enhance user focus. Figure 15 depicts a multiple-choice question type, where a 
dominating header is followed by a passively styled description, conveying a 
hierarchical structure; further enhancing user flow, by enabling the user to 
simply glance at the page before starting the question.  
To align with modern applications the lesson will employ a TikTok style scrolling 
mechanism, thereby reducing extraneous load. Subsequent lesson items will 
become available after the user completes each question, giving students the 
ability to regulate their learning (Carter Jr, et al., 2020).
